summary: Iteration 48 — Phase MKT.2 (Ad Format Selector + Spin/Scratch instant-win + Prize Giveaway + Radio Directory scaling) tested end-to-end on backend and mobile. Backend pytest test_iter48_mkt2.py: 26/26 PASS. Regression iter47 (25) + iter46 (18) = 43/43 PASS. Backend coverage: (1) GET /api/rate-card/formats returns 4 formats (banner/audio/push/video) each with pricing_model + base_cents from rate card; requires auth (401 anon). (2) POST /api/merchant/marketplace/campaigns: bad type → 400 bad_campaign_type; giveaway missing prize_desc → 400 prize_required; spin/scratch/giveaway all created OK with correct type-specific fields (win_points, win_probability, prize_label / prize_desc, num_winners, drawn=False). (3) GET /api/brand-games/active lists active spin/scratch (excludes budget-exhausted); per-user 'played' state stamped; POST /brand-games/{id}/play — first play with win_probability=1.0 → won=true awarded=25 points; second play → 409 already_played; scratch campaign with 5-cent budget auto-paused (status=paused) after a single play (instant_win_game rate 12c > 5c budget). (4) GET /api/brand-giveaways/active lists active giveaways; POST /brand-giveaways/{id}/enter awards reward_points_on_entry (3pts); repeat → 409 already_entered; per-user entered flag surfaces on active feed. (5) POST /merchant/marketplace/campaigns/{id}/draw owner-only — spin id → 400 not_a_giveaway; giveaway → 200 with winners=min(num_winners,entries), status→paused+drawn=true; repeat draw → 400 already_drawn; drawn giveaway excluded from active feed. (6) GET /api/radio/browse?source=imported now hits DB-level paginated fast path — total >1000 (real catalog), page=1 & page=3 both return items, q=search works, counts_by_source.imported == total; source=all merged path unchanged and still returns counts_by_source with all 3 keys. (7) GET /api/admin/rate-card returns 9+ items now — includes instant_win_game + giveaway_entry alongside prior 7; PUT still rejects bad pricing_model with 400. Mobile (Expo web preview, viewport 390×844, demo bearer): /brand-games renders brand-games-root with 3 bg-campaign-* rows — 2 already won (bg-result-* green chip 'You won +25 points!' from iter48 test + smoke), 1 still playable (bg-play-* on Scratch & Win Coffee). /brand-giveaways renders brand-giveaways-root; the iter48 giveaway auto-disappeared post-draw (correct), 1 remaining active row (Weekend Brunch) with gv-enter-* button. /advertiser/campaign/new step 1 shows all 4 wizard-format-{banner,audio,push,video} cards with CPM/CPA prices ($8/$15/$0.10/$20); tapping Video Ad correctly marks it selected (orange highlight). /merchant/marketplace: goal 'engagement' offers mkt-type-{trivia,spin,scratch}; goal 'awareness' offers mkt-type-{giveaway,trivia,coupon_bid} — spin form renders mkt-win-pts + mkt-win-prob + mkt-prize-label; giveaway form renders mkt-prize-desc + mkt-num-winners. Campaign list shows 14 campaigns (leftover TEST_ + smoke rows), each with mkt-toggle-*, and exactly 1 mkt-draw-* button (the not-yet-drawn Weekend Brunch giveaway). /earn shows all 3 brand entry-points: earn-brand-trivia + earn-brand-games + earn-brand-giveaways. All MKT.2 spec testIDs are present and integrated with backend APIs.

critical_code_review_comments: merchant_marketplace.brand_game_play: cost_usd = rate.base_cents/100 (default 12c) is fixed and NOT tied to win/lose outcome — a losing play costs the merchant just as much as a winning one. Consider CPA-style billing (charge only on win) or a smaller loss cost, since 'instant_win_game' pricing_model is CPA in the rate card but the code charges every play.

merchant_marketplace.brand_game_play & brand_giveaway_enter: race between insert into plays/entries and the merchant_campaigns $inc/spent_usd update — if the insert succeeds but the update fails (transient DB error), the play is 'burned' idempotently but the spend/plays counter is not incremented. Consider wrapping in a transaction or writing the counter first with a rollback path.

merchant_marketplace.draw_giveaway: uses random.sample with no seeded RNG and no audit trail — winners are only stored on the campaign doc. No draw_log collection for auditing (e.g., 'who was in the pool when the draw ran'). Consider persisting entrants snapshot for fairness disputes.

merchant_marketplace.brand_game_play: `awarded: 0` is inserted first, then updated on win via a second write. Under a slow update or a race, GET /brand-games/active could observe played.awarded=0 for a winner briefly. Not user-visible in practice but worth folding into a single atomic upsert with won+awarded set together.

radio_unified._browse_imported_fast: `counts_by_source={'bigfm_ai': 0, 'community': 0, 'imported': total}` shadows the merged shape. Frontends that read total from `counts_by_source` values will see 0 for AI/community even when source=imported filters them out — intended, but document explicitly since the merged branch computes those counts differently.

radio_unified.browse (merged path): the merged AI+community+imported path still uses the 2000-doc materialize+merge — pagination past ~66 pages on 'source=all' will still degrade. The MKT.2 fix is imported-only. Consider extending the fast path when source is a superset that includes imported.
